sku.label: SKU
sku.help: Generated automatically and independent of category names.

primaryCategory.label: Primary category
primaryCategory.help: Defines the product specifications and title guidance.

additionalCategories.label: Additional categories
additionalCategories.help: Optional extra locations where the product should appear.

bgSlug.label: Bulgarian product address
bgSlug.help: The final segment of the Bulgarian address. The full example below includes the real domain and selected primary-category path. It can be edited until first publication.

enSlug.label: English product address
enSlug.help: The final segment of the English address. The full example below includes /en, the real category path, and the product address. It can be edited until first publication.

trSlug.label: Turkish product address
trSlug.help: Optional Turkish address. Leave it empty to use the English product address for the Turkish version.

ukSlug.label: Ukrainian product address
ukSlug.help: Optional Ukrainian address. Leave it empty to use the English product address for the Ukrainian version.

mpn.label: Model (MPN)
mpn.help: The required official model or product code assigned by the manufacturer.

salesMode.label: Sales mode
salesMode.help: Choose direct purchase or enquiry-only handling.

pricePresentation.label: Price presentation
pricePresentation.help: Choose an exact price, a starting price, or price on request.

price.label: Entered price in EUR
price.help: Enter the amount using up to two decimal places.

priceEntryBasis.label: VAT basis
priceEntryBasis.help: Choose whether the entered amount includes 20% VAT.

availability.label: Availability
availability.help: Choose availability manually; quantities are not tracked.

title.label: Product title
title.help: The public product name in this language.

shortDescription.label: Short description
shortDescription.help: A concise summary for product listings.

fullDescription.label: Full description
fullDescription.help: The complete product description in this language.

marketingLabel.label: Marketing label
marketingLabel.help: Optional short label displayed with the product.

seoTitle.label: SEO title
seoTitle.help: Optional search title. The product title is used when this is empty.

metaDescription.label: Meta description
metaDescription.help: May appear below the title and address in search results.

mediaReference.label: Media reference
mediaReference.help: Use an existing site path or HTTPS URL.

altText.label: Alternative text
altText.help: Describe this image in the selected language.

specifications.empty: This product has no active specifications.
specifications.removed: Specifications removed only from this product
specifications.customHelp: This specification applies only to this product.

customName.label: Specification name
customName.help: Enter the name in the selected language.

customType.label: Type
customType.help: Controls how the value is entered.

customUnit.label: Unit
customUnit.help: Optional unit, such as W or kg.

customOption.label: Option
customOption.help: The option name in the selected language.

specifications.categoryChangePending: The new inherited specifications will load after the primary-category change is saved.
